Hounslow's Junior international Sam Haughian was awesome as he destroyed the chances of Taylor and his club-mate Simpson — one of the best individual wins for a long time.

Thames Hare & Hounds were first Surrey team followed by Ranelagh and South London while Borough of Hounslow, first across the finish line, were helped no end by Sam Haughian running day's fastest time on lap 1 and then second fastest when he turned out again for lap 4.
